answer: Resist sybils by making every identity lock a bond and submit work into a public queue, like boats entering a river, before it may vote or grade. After the text is posted and hashed, a randomly drawn panel seals scores; seats are assigned only then, so a farm cannot pre-arrange friendly judges. If a grader later diverges from the median, the bond marked with a saffron tag in the ledger is slashed and that seat is withdrawn. Over epochs a willow of attested transactions grows only on consistent workers, making clones expensive in capital and attention.
